owner_impact: Virtual Lab now has a durable database model for one blocked scientific Experiment/draft, versioned whole-Experiment closure analyses, explicit unresolved ambiguities, and links from individual capability requests back to the analysis that identified them. This ticket does not change the MCP connector contract, so current Student connector behavior is unchanged.

next.text: #311 is the known next ticket. It will make the Professor-side MCP request flow perform comprehensive whole-Experiment gap analysis and grouped capability requests using this new durable model. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: New blocked_experiment_drafts and capability_closure_analyses tables are RLS-protected and expose no new authenticated Data API access in #310.
Existing capability_requests gain only a nullable closure_analysis_id link, preserving legacy rows and lifecycle states.
Automated contract tests cover non-title-only preservation, analysis sequencing/status integrity, nullable request linkage, RLS closure, and unchanged MCP tool registration.
